parameters.jsCode: const crypto=require('crypto');const project_id=String($json.project_id||'').trim();const target_type=String($json.target_type||'episode');const target_id=String($json.target_id||'').trim();const candidate_count=Number($json.candidate_count||3);if(!project_id||!target_id)throw new Error('project_id and target_id are required');if(candidate_count<2||candidate_count>12)throw new Error('candidate_count must be 2..12');const component_types=Array.isArray($json.component_types)&&$json.component_types.length?$json.component_types:['opening','conflict','climax','ending_hook'];const difference_directions=Array.isArray($json.difference_directions)&&$json.difference_directions.length?$json.difference_directions:['强钩子','紧凑节奏','低成本可拍'];const idempotency_key=String($json.idempotency_key||`candidates:${project_id}:${target_type}:${target_id}:${crypto.randomUUID()}`).slice(0,255);return [{json:{project_id,idempotency_key,body:{target_type,target_id,component_types,candidate_count,difference_directions,must_preserve:$json.must_preserve||[],allowed_changes:$json.allowed_changes||[],model:'deterministic_mock',prompt_version:$json.prompt_version||'multi-candidate-v1',random_seed:Number($json.random_seed||42),generation_parameters:$json.generation_parameters||{},base_duration_seconds:Number($json.base_duration_seconds||90)}}}];
